author: Claude Opus 5.5 (assistant session) at the owner's request; owner acceptance pending through the review of PR #24
reason: PR #24 review at e8c588f: execute checked host readiness only at the start; during transfer() only Guard.check() (free space) ran, so the preregistered host abort criteria were not watched while bytes flow and the start GO could go stale.

This amendment adds a read-only, bounded in-run monitor (tools/hostmonitor10.py) that applies the frozen host_memory_preflight.abort_criteria during the acquisition, stops cooperatively, keeps the owned .part and allows resume only after a new hostgate10 GO.
The amended inventory and the local attestation path follow the new and changed test files; the runner-unverifiable set is unchanged.

invariants.note: abort thresholds, sustain times and actions are read from the frozen protocol.json; the amendment only states what each action means for an acquisition and how sampling is bounded

acquisition_host_monitor.rule: acquire10 --execute starts the monitor under the lock after the second host gate check and before the first payload request; no first valid sample within startup_timeout_s, or a first sample that already meets a stop condition, refuses the payload. While bytes flow the monitor is polled before each request and after each chunk. A stop condition (frozen abort criterion whose action maps to stop, sustain times as preregistered), no valid sample for more than max_unmonitored_s, or a dead sampler raise HostPressureStop: the owned .part and its marker are kept, the lock is released, the sampler child is terminated, the stop evidence includes the monitor summary. Resume = a new acquire10 --execute with a new fresh hostgate10 GO; the .part is re-hashed and only the remainder is requested. A sample is valid only if every abort quantity is readable (paging rate may be absent only on the first sample). The sampler is one powershell.exe running read-only CIM queries; nothing on Windows or WSL is changed.
acquisition_host_monitor.limits: reaction latency up to one sampling interval plus the preregistered sustain time; stops this acquisition only; one powershell.exe sampler (about 100 MB) for the duration of the transfer

not_verifiable_on_runner.skip_message: local unsanitized originals are not on this machine
not_verifiable_on_runner.cause: tests/test_increment9_hardening.py "-real" cases need the local unsanitized M9 originals, which are deliberately not in Git (sanitization of increment 9)

ci_runner_verification.rule: runner verdict PASS = every runner-verifiable required test passed, nothing missing, extra or duplicated, and each declared test either passed or was skipped with exactly the declared message; such a skip is NOT VERIFIABLE ON RUNNER and keeps the full-inventory verdict of the runner at NOT PROVEN. The archived local attestation must be a full PASS of the same inventory with its pinned JUnit SHA256. CI succeeds only if both hold.
